title: Fields of definition of dynamical systems on $ mathbb{P}^{1}$. Improvements on a result of Silverman

predicted_errors.error_location: Section 1, paragraph after the definition of N_phi (before Lemma 4)
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The text asserts a short exact sequence 1 -> A_phi -> N_phi -> Gal(K/k). This is not surjective in general: Lemma 4 itself proves the image is Gal(K/k_xi), which is a proper subgroup of Gal(K/k) whenever k_xi != k. Thus the sequence to Gal(K/k) is not short exact.

predicted_errors.error_location: Lemma 4, proof of the converse direction
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: From phi^sigma = tau_sigma phi tau_sigma^{-1} = f phi f^{-1}, the paper claims that tau_sigma circ f^{-1} lies in N_phi. The element that commutes with phi is f^{-1} circ tau_sigma, since (f^{-1} tau_sigma) phi (f^{-1} tau_sigma)^{-1} = f^{-1}(tau_sigma phi tau_sigma^{-1}) f = f^{-1}(f phi f^{-1}) f = phi. The claimed tau_sigma f^{-1} does not generally commute with phi.

The proof of Lemma 11 says: 'In general, there exists an extension k'/k_xi of degree at most 2 with P_xi(k') nonempty, hence xi descends to P^1_{k'} by Lemma 11.' This uses Lemma 11 to prove a consequence while purporting to prove Lemma 11, and it does not prove the stated equivalence in Lemma 11. As written, the proof is circular/incomplete.

predicted_errors.error_location: Final section, proof of condition (4) (ramification-index condition)
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The proof states that if char k != 2, |S(K)| odd is equivalent to S having odd degree, and then concludes P(k_xi) is nonempty by Lemma 27. In characteristic 2, this equivalence is not established. Since a finite reduced scheme in characteristic 2 can have one geometric point but degree 2, odd |S(K)| does not imply odd degree. The proof therefore has a gap in characteristic 2.
